items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I know it was led by Peter Boccoff over in Algiers. I played lots of funerals with them on that.

ctx.x: Did they still have some of the old onward band at that time? I didn't know they called it that.

Well, that's what I'm thinking now. I placed several parades and funerals with it, but I know it was led by Peter Boccoff over in Algiers. I played lots of funerals with them on that. I think it was called the Onward Brass Band, part of it. Peter might explain it more better.
Yeah, I don't remember that he told us about that particular group.
